Let's say Melanie started with x vacuum cleaners.
She sold a third of her vacuum cleaners, so she sold x/3 vacuum cleaners.
She sold 2 more to the red house, so she had x/3 - 2 vacuum cleaners left.
She sold half of what was left at the orange house, so she sold (x/3 - 2)/2 vacuum cleaners.
After selling at the orange house, she had (x/3 - 2) - (x/3 - 2)/2 vacuum cleaners left.
We know that she has 5 vacuum cleaners left, so we can set up the equation (x/3 - 2) - (x/3 - 2)/2 = 5.
Simplifying the equation, we get (x/3 - 2) - (x/6 - 1) = 5.
Combining like terms, we get (x/3 - 2) - (x/6 - 1) = 5.
Simplifying further, we get (2x/6 - 2) - (x/6 - 1) = 5.
Combining like terms again, we get (2x/6 - x/6) - (2 - 1) = 5.
Simplifying once more, we get (x/6) - 1 = 5.
Adding 1 to both sides, we get (x/6) = 6.
Multiplying both sides by 6, we get x = 36.
Therefore, Melanie started with 36 vacuum cleaners.
